## History

Minnie May is the young baby sister of [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). While her parents were away from home, she fell severely ill with a life-threatening case of the croup. [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) treated Minnie May through the night using her past experience with young children until [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) arrived with a doctor. ## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--minnie-may.md)

When Minnie May fell desperately ill with croup while her parents were away, [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) drew on her past experience caring for young children to treat her throughout the night. Anne's intervention saved Minnie May's life before the doctor arrived. As a result of this act, Minnie May's mother fully forgave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) for a previous incident, allowing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to resume her cherished friendship with Minnie May's sister, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).

- Saved by  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P43](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0043)</sub>
